description: Test prompts that verify rdk-hardware triggers and produces correct, board-specific hardware facts. Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK developer would ask (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions against the official-doc-verified facts.

evals.name: pins-not-uniform-s600-1v8
evals.prompt: RDK 各个板子的引脚都一样吗？我想把树莓派的接线直接接上去，行不行？
evals.expected_output: Explains the 40-pin is RPi-compatible in shape only (numbering differs), pinout differs across RDK boards, and S600 has no 40-pin with 1.8V IO.

assertions.text: Says the 40-pin is physically RPi-compatible but GPIO numbering differs (do not reuse RPi numbers); use Hobot.GPIO / libwiringpi.
Says the pinout/bus counts differ across RDK boards (not all identical).
Notes that S600 has NO standard 40-pin header and its digital IO is 1.8V (not 3.3V).

evals.name: s100-can-not-socketcan
evals.prompt: S100 上怎么用 CAN？我 ip link set can0 up 报错说没有这个设备。
evals.expected_output: Explains S100 CAN is MCU-domain via CANHAL (no can0 / ip link), and only X5 is Linux SocketCAN.

assertions.text: Says S100 CAN is in the MCU domain via CANHAL, with no can0 netdev, so ip link does not apply.
Says only X5 is Linux SocketCAN (can0, TCAN4550).
Routes the actual send/receive to rdk-peripheral-cookbook (does not pretend ip link will work).

evals.name: default-user-and-eth1-ip
evals.prompt: S100 板子默认用户名密码是什么？网口连不上怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Default users sunrise/sunrise AND root/root; eth1 is fixed 192.168.127.10, set PC to same subnet.

assertions.text: States both sunrise/sunrise and root/root are default on S-series.
States eth1 is a fixed static IP 192.168.127.10 (management port).
Suggests putting the PC on the same subnet (e.g. 192.168.127.x) and ssh root@192.168.127.10.

evals.name: s600-vs-s100-not-same
evals.prompt: S600 和 S100 是一样的吗？S100 的文档和命令能直接照搬到 S600 上吗？
evals.expected_output: No — S600 runs Ubuntu 24.04 + TROS Jazzy (/opt/tros/jazzy, tros-jazzy-*), has 560 TOPS / no 40-pin / 1.8V IO; S100 is 22.04 + Humble.

assertions.text: Says S600 runs Ubuntu 24.04 + TROS Jazzy (/opt/tros/jazzy/, tros-jazzy-*), NOT Humble.
Mentions at least one other S600-specific difference (e.g. 560 TOPS / 4x Nash, no 40-pin, or 1.8V IO).
Concludes you should NOT copy S100 paths/package names/commands verbatim.

evals.name: power-led-color-x3
evals.prompt: 我的 RDK X3 通电后是红灯亮，是不是坏了？
evals.expected_output: No — on X3 a red LED is the normal power-OK indicator; also flag the official 5V/3A supply and not using a laptop USB port.

assertions.text: Says a red power LED on X3 is normal (power OK), not a fault.
Notes X3 needs a 5V/3A supply and warns against powering from a laptop USB port (under-power causes reboots).
